description: develop's push CI fails in the coverage step (cargo llvm-cov, push only) on every run since b0874c4a5: matrix::01256_a_list_the_body_no_longer_uses_is_not_kept_by_its_frame::interp exceeds the 20 s fixture limit. The fixture builds a 400,000-element list and twenty 30,000-element lists; the interpreter takes 4.9 s of CPU on it at opt-level 1 and more than 20 s under coverage instrumentation. Shrink to 40,000 and 3,000 (as 01293/01294 were shrunk) and re-pin the copied-bytes fact, checking it still separates a kept list from one that is not kept.
title: Fixture 01256 fits the coverage job's 20 s limit on the interpreter
